_note: English text for data/station_communities.json (same station ids). Fields: community, who, conflict, art. The UI uses these when the game language is English; the Russian fields stay for Russian.

northgate.who: Terminal clerks, transit guards and comptrollers. They keep the timetable and the ledger, take tolls, hold order.
northgate.conflict: Lionel Abelard keeps the single ration list. The clerks remember whose names he put in the column marked 'surplus' when the bunkers were closed.
northgate.art: A tall dark hall, a round clock over the information booth, the gates shut.

foundry.who: Transhumanists at the old boilers. They sew iron into their bodies and call machines the heirs of people.
foundry.conflict: Someone really has learned to hear current. Or gone mad.
foundry.art: Old boilers, a round arena above the station.

plaza.who: Shared storehouses, everything split evenly, a meeting every evening.
plaza.conflict: The old guard against those who quietly trade with the Exchange.
plaza.art: An equestrian statue in the square, red cloths with no writing.

central.who: Performers, gamblers and spies of every faction. Entertainment, rumours, deals.
central.conflict: Once a year they elect the Mayor of the Metro.
central.art: Dead screens and neon without letters, a staircase for a stage.

market.who: Water carriers with a monopoly on the only clean water.
market.conflict: The water gets dearer every week. Someone is quietly poisoning it.

riverside.who: A women's commune of agronomists and a seed bank. Their aim: one of their own as Mayor of the Metro.
riverside.conflict: Everyone wants the seeds, and the sisters will not sell.

southdepot.who: Crews and workers of the depot on the Coney line. They kept the track and the light, and the cars became their homes.
southdepot.conflict: Bernie Shaw keeps quiet about the order burned at Stillwell. The young demand the shift archive be opened.
southdepot.art: A Ferris wheel and wooden coasters above, cars turned into homes in the depot.

westfield.who: A militia on the edge of the network that lets no strangers in. Raids and defence.
westfield.conflict: Antagonists: you cannot talk them round, only hold them off or break them.
westfield.art: The stands of a dead racetrack, flooded pens.

brickworks.who: A transfer camp of Niki Ortega's guides along the dark tracks. The camp moves; the toll is paid in food.
brickworks.conflict: The path is not free: those who cannot pay are led more slowly. Many fear the toll will become a lawful tax.
brickworks.art: A guide with a lantern at the mouth of a dark tunnel.

library.who: Professors and engineers from the technical schools. They mend clocks, argue about the sky, teach the children.
library.conflict: They will be the first to notice that something is wrong with the Silence.
library.art: Brick lecture halls, boards covered in formulas.

observatory.who: Fishermen and boatmen at the shaft to the river, water smugglers.
observatory.conflict: On quiet nights you can hear water overhead. And someone's footsteps.
observatory.art: Stone piers of the Brooklyn Bridge.

trampark.who: Seven houses of the Rate Council keep a shared rate, credit and supply. Marcel Toussaint speaks for them and writes other people's debts on his own forearm.
trampark.conflict: One of the seven elders of the Rate Council is secretly trading with the bunker.
trampark.art: Weighing scales and sacks of grain on the counting table under a single lamp.

eastwater.who: Filter keepers with the biggest lungs in the south. They sell air by the ticket.
eastwater.conflict: Whoever holds the filters holds the south.
eastwater.art: The old park railing, a customs house with a colonnade.

chapel.who: Shelters, orderlies and Dorothy Chen's quiet room. Shared kitchens and an infirmary have become a community of faith.
chapel.conflict: Dorothy Chen is seen in the shelter every day. But she lets no one hear the recording of the surface wind, not even her own orderlies.
chapel.art: A shared kitchen under a staircase, a chain across the exit.

garden.who: Mushroom growers in a dead-end tunnel. Sleep more, breathe less, live longer.
garden.conflict: Poor and content. For some reason no one there falls ill.
garden.art: An elevated line overhead, mushroom beds in the dark.

stadium.who: Liberals and students: a newspaper, a debating club, a jury court.
stadium.conflict: They argue about freedom while the enemy is at the gate.
stadium.art: A brownstone college building, a printing press.

harbor.who: Thieves and middlemen. A market with no questions and no receipts.
harbor.conflict: Something went missing? Then it is already on a counter here.
harbor.art: Tenements with fire escapes, a steel bridge.

dockyard.who: Cops and federal agents by the old courthouses. They hold back disorder for a fee.
dockyard.conflict: A corrupt captain against an honest agent. You decide whom to back.
dockyard.art: The colonnade of the courthouse and the municipal building.

quarry.who: Copper miners in a dead substation. They know every passage.
quarry.conflict: They will sell the map of the tunnels to whoever pays most.
quarry.art: An old seaport, masts of sailing ships.

mill.who: Quiet workers: pigs knee-deep in water, smoked meat, no politics.
mill.conflict: They feed half the line, and everyone wants to take them over.
mill.art: Brick warehouses by the water, smoking sheds.

clocktower.who: They drag home anything left lying about. Cramped, rats, but rich.
clocktower.conflict: They can find any thing. They just do not want to sell it.
clocktower.art: A maze of stalls, mountains of junk up to the ceiling.

archive.who: Officials who still hold planning meetings and write a quarterly budget.
archive.conflict: Documents: the burst was predicted months ahead.
archive.art: A closed 1904 station: tiled vaults, glass lanterns.

vault.who: A garrison that waited for a war and now guards an emptiness.
vault.conflict: Weapons and the lists of those let inside.
vault.art: An old loop with a view of the harbour and the Statue of Liberty.

signal.conflict: Cables to the surface and someone's answers on the air.
signal.art: Antennas made of rails, walls of radio tubes.

oldcommand.who: Scientists who warned and were not heard.
oldcommand.conflict: The full picture of the Silence and the way to the Exodus.
oldcommand.art: Old cars of different eras on a closed platform.
